title: Rizia/Prologue
description: The pre-story of King Romus Toras. Depiction of the history of Rizia, Toras family, Romus personal life choices.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You opened your eyes to this realm."
entries.dialogueText:
You opened your eyes to this realm.

Becoming a king was never your choice.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...quickly became close friends."
entries.dialogueText: ...quickly became close friends.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...enjoyed bossing him around."
entries.dialogueText: ...enjoyed bossing him around.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your region came to see you as a cr..."
entries.dialogueText:
Your region came to see you as a cruel but capable leader.

One day, the king came for an unannounced visit. He brought with him a pale-skinned young woman with striking blue eyes.

Hesitantly, she introduced herself as Lena Livingston -- the sister of Queen Beatrice of Rumburg, and your wife-to-be.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You bowed."
entries.dialogueText: You bowed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You demanded to know what was going..."
entries.dialogueText: You demanded to know what was going on.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "King Valero told you that he had no..."
entries.dialogueText:
King Valero told you that he had no choice. 

With Wehlen descending into civil war, Rizia needed a new ally.

A partnership with the Kingdom of Rumburg, cemented with an arranged marriage, was in the best interest of both monarchies.

Besides, he added, you would surely grow to love her.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "He was right."
entries.dialogueText: He was right.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "He was wrong."
entries.dialogueText: He was wrong.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You and Lena went on a few dates, b..."
entries.dialogueText:
You and Lena went on a few dates, but neither of you felt a spark. By the time you lifted her veil, you knew the marriage was a sham.

For your countries' sake, you slept together a few times. One of those resulted in the birth of your daughter, Vina. 

After she was born, you...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The uprising had other consequences..."
entries.dialogueText:
The uprising had other consequences.

The traitor Lucas Sazon was executed, and his pregnant wife sent into exile. As further punishment, Iza -- the capital city of Brenas, and the Sazons' ancestral home -- was handed over to your family.

Your uncle Hugo was sent to serve as its steward. In turn, you were to take his place as reigning Duke of Valenqiris.

At your childhood home in Monqiz, you...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...focused on finding and punishing..."
entries.dialogueText: ...focused on finding and punishing the remaining traitors to the throne.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...largely ignored your duties and..."
entries.dialogueText: ...largely ignored your duties and lived a life of leisure.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...did your best to help your regio..."
entries.dialogueText: ...did your best to help your region rebuild.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You and Lena began having hours-lon..."
entries.dialogueText:
You and Lena began having hours-long conversations about your royal upbringings, hopes and dreams.

By the time you lifted her veil, you knew it was true love.

The years after your wedding and the birth of your daughter Vina were the happiest of your life. 

The only trouble was...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "But it was too late."
entries.dialogueText: But it was too late.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You were devastated. After the f..."
entries.dialogueText:
You were devastated.

After the funeral, your mother Estela came to visit and found you hardly able to function. She promptly moved in to help out with Vina. 

Hugo suggested you turn to Wruhecism, Rizia's official religion, to cope with your loss.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "If anything, you became less of a b..."
entries.dialogueText: If anything, you became less of a believer.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You mourned for a while. But you..."
entries.dialogueText:
You mourned for a while.

But you also had a province to lead and a young daughter to care for. Your mother Estela moved in to help out with Vina. 

Hugo suggested you turn to Wruhecism, Rizia's official religion, to cope with your loss.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Meanwhile, the situation in the cap..."
entries.dialogueText:
Meanwhile, the situation in the capital worsened.

Rizian nationalists continued protesting the loss of Zille and the country’s growing pluralism. Rumors spread that an anti-monarchist movement was growing once more. Several long-operating gold mines were depleting as the expenses of the kingdom grew. 

Your father called Hugo back from Iza to keep an eye on his council.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You reasoned the King had brought h..."
entries.dialogueText: You reasoned the King had brought his troubles on himself.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Outsiders also took notice of the k..."
entries.dialogueText:
Outsiders also took notice of the king's decline.

One of them was Axel Reinhart, the new ruler of the Grand Duchy of Pales.

He sent you an invitation to visit him, on two conditions: You were to go alone, and without your father's knowledge.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You accepted."
entries.dialogueText: You accepted.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "It was your first time in Pales sin..."
entries.dialogueText:
It was your first time in Pales since childhood. You were surprised at how modern everything seemed now.

Duke Reinhart welcomed you to his palace. He said he was hoping to re-establish relations with Rizia once you became king.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...told him that would only be poss..."
entries.dialogueText: ...told him that would only be possible once Pales rejoined Rizia, where it belonged.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...said you were looking forward to..."
entries.dialogueText: ...said you were looking forward to putting the past behind you.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...agreed that a thaw between Rizia..."
entries.dialogueText: ...agreed that a thaw between Rizia and Pales could be lucrative on both sides.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The duke was taken aback and ordere..."
entries.dialogueText:
The duke was taken aback and ordered you to leave at once.

Afterwards, you...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The duke was satisfied with your an..."
entries.dialogueText:
The duke was satisfied with your answer. You spent the next few days getting to know him and the duchy better.

Afterwards, you...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He'd gone straight to bed after din..."
entries.dialogueText:
He'd gone straight to bed after dinner. When your mother went to check in on him later, she found him comatose in the bedroom.

The doctors suspected a heart attack.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You rushed to see him."
entries.dialogueText: You rushed to see him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You stayed where you were."
entries.dialogueText: You stayed where you were.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your father looked pale as a ghost...."
entries.dialogueText:
Your father looked pale as a ghost. It took all his effort to speak.

In a hoarse whisper, he warned you not to follow in his footsteps.

Your reign would be a fresh start for House Toras. A new chance to take back the lands that were lost.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The next day, King Valero Toras was..."
entries.dialogueText:
The next day, King Valero Toras was no more.

You and Vina traveled to Porte Drazon to comfort your mother.

She handed you a note your father had written you.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "He closed his eyes."
entries.dialogueText: He closed his eyes.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "His last words."
entries.dialogueText: His last words.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the letter, he warned you not to..."
entries.dialogueText:
In the letter, he warned you not to follow in his footsteps.

Your reign would be a fresh start for House Toras. A new chance to take back the lands that were lost.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Only after his funeral, gathered at..."
entries.dialogueText:
Only after his funeral, gathered at the palace with your mother and daughter, did the realization begin to dawn on you.

From the day you were born, your entire life had been leading to this moment.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You fought back tears."
entries.dialogueText: You fought back tears.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Now, it was finally here."
entries.dialogueText: Now, it was finally here.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You threw it away."
entries.dialogueText: You threw it away.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "It was your birthright."
entries.dialogueText: It was your birthright.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "It was your burden."
entries.dialogueText: It was your burden.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "It was your calling."
entries.dialogueText: It was your calling.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "From a young age, you knew you were..."
entries.dialogueText:
From a young age, you knew you were no ordinary child. 

You were Romus Toras. Grandson of Queen Lyza, ruler of all of Rizia. Son of Crown Prince Valero, the Duke of Valenqiris.

For most of the year, you lived with your father Valero and your mother Estela in a lavish palace atop the cliffs of Monqiz. Each summer, though, you...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...visited your mother's common-bor..."
entries.dialogueText: ...visited your mother's common-born family at their home by the Zille harbor.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...stayed with the Queen at the roy..."
entries.dialogueText: ...stayed with the Queen at the royal residence in Porte Drazon.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...went hunting with your father's..."
entries.dialogueText: ...went hunting with your father's brother Hugo in the forests of Brenas.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your uncle taught you more than jus..."
entries.dialogueText:
Your uncle taught you more than just how to hold and aim a gun. 

You learned the value of staying patient and keeping your eyes and ears open at all times.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You were fascinated by the splendor..."
entries.dialogueText: You were fascinated by the splendor of your surroundings and the intricacies of your grandmother's court.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your grandparents were fisherpeople..."
entries.dialogueText: Your grandparents were fisherpeople of modest means, and staying with them helped you feel grounded.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When Queen Lyza died, the whole cou..."
entries.dialogueText:
When Queen Lyza died, the whole country grieved.

But the mourning could only last for so long.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...asked him about the rumors."
entries.dialogueText: ...asked him about the rumors.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...didn't mention either."
entries.dialogueText: ...didn't mention either.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your father laughed and told you ce..."
entries.dialogueText:
Your father laughed and told you certain other royals had never approved of him marrying a commoner.

But he and Estela were in love. And love conquered all.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your father laughed and told you th..."
entries.dialogueText:
Your father laughed and told you that some people had come to believe Rizia shouldn't be ruled by a monarch anymore.

But of course, he assured you, they were wrong.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You had your doubts."
entries.dialogueText: You had your doubts.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Life in Porte Drazon was less excit..."
entries.dialogueText:
Life in Porte Drazon was less exciting than you expected. You were tutored privately and rarely had contact with non-royals.

At the palace, the closest person to your age was Pabel, the groundskeeper's son -- a quiet but friendly kid who knew about every plant in the gardens. You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...didn't have much to do with each..."
entries.dialogueText: ...didn't have much to do with each other.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When you came of age, your father i..."
entries.dialogueText: When you came of age, your father invited you to start sitting in on royal council meetings. You decided...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...that you would love to join."
entries.dialogueText: ...that you would love to join.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...to go to university instead."
entries.dialogueText: ...to go to university instead.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...to join the military instead."
entries.dialogueText: ...to join the military instead.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The council members took you under..."
entries.dialogueText:
The council members took you under their wing, catching you up on the issues of the day.

One of their main concerns was Pales, a former part of Rizia that had long belonged to the Empire of Valgos.

Now that the empire had fallen, war councilor General Taddeus Azaro was launching a military campaign to take the newly independent region back. You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At the prestigious University of Iz..."
entries.dialogueText:
At the prestigious University of Iza, you studied history, politics and economics to prepare for your eventual reign.

In one of your classes, an argument broke out about Pales, a former part of Rizia that had long belonged to the Empire of Valgos.

Now that the empire had fallen, your father's government was launching a military campaign to take the newly independent region back. You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Every autumn, you returned home a l..."
entries.dialogueText: Every autumn, you returned home a little wiser.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You believed him."
entries.dialogueText: You believed him.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...thought it was a lost cause."
entries.dialogueText: ...thought it was a lost cause.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...agreed that it was time to recon..."
entries.dialogueText: ...agreed that it was time to reconquer the territory.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...didn't have an opinion either wa..."
entries.dialogueText: ...didn't have an opinion either way.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At the prestigious Camp Domus acade..."
entries.dialogueText:
At the prestigious Camp Domus academy in the mountains of Montaklar, you learned about war strategy and combat tactics.

One day, the royal war councillor, General Taddeus Azaro, came to visit. He announced a military campaign on Pales, a former part of Rizia that had long belonged to the Empire of Valgos.

Now that the empire had fallen, he said, the time was right to take the region back. You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As you continued to serve on the co..."
entries.dialogueText:
As you continued to serve on the council, the Reclamation War dragged on.

It seemed like an easy victory until your northern neighbor Lespia got involved, sending weapons and financial aid to Pales.

Protests against the war sprouted up around the country. You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As you continued your studies, the..."
entries.dialogueText:
As you continued your studies, the Reclamation War dragged on.

It seemed like an easy victory until your northern neighbor Lespia got involved, sending weapons and financial aid to Pales.

Protests against the war sprouted up on campus. You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You weren't allowed to fight on the..."
entries.dialogueText:
You weren't allowed to fight on the ground, so you watched from General Azaro's headquarters as the Reclamation War dragged on.

It seemed like an easy victory until your northern neighbor Lespia got involved, sending weapons and financial aid to Pales.

Dissent began brewing among your fellow recruits. You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...asked your father to stop the bl..."
entries.dialogueText: ...asked your father to stop the bloodshed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...demanded that he crack down on t..."
entries.dialogueText: ...demanded that he crack down on the traitors.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...refrained from taking sides."
entries.dialogueText: ...refrained from taking sides.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Some troops were withdrawn, but the..."
entries.dialogueText:
Some troops were withdrawn, but the fire had been lit.

Your next council meeting was interrupted by the announcement that the navy had mutinied. Bloody clashes between pro- and anti-monarchists were erupting across the country.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "The Century of Revolutions had reac..."
entries.dialogueText: The Century of Revolutions had reached Rizia at last.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Some troops were withdrawn, but the..."
entries.dialogueText:
Some troops were withdrawn, but the fire had been lit.

The next day, class was interrupted by the announcement that the navy had mutinied. Bloody clashes between pro- and anti-monarchists were erupting across the country.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Some troops were withdrawn, but the..."
entries.dialogueText:
Some troops were withdrawn, but the fire had been lit.

The next day, General Azaro burst into headquarters with the news that the navy had mutinied. Bloody clashes between pro- and anti-monarchists were erupting across the country.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few arrests were made, but the fi..."
entries.dialogueText:
A few arrests were made, but the fire had been lit.

Your next council meeting was interrupted by the announcement that the navy had mutinied. Bloody clashes between pro- and anti-monarchists were erupting across the country.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few arrests were made, but the fi..."
entries.dialogueText:
A few arrests were made, but the fire had been lit.

The next day, class was interrupted by the announcement that the navy had mutinied. Bloody clashes between pro- and anti-monarchists were erupting across the country.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few arrests were made, but the fi..."
entries.dialogueText:
A few arrests were made, but the fire had been lit.

The next day, General Azaro burst into headquarters with the news that the navy had mutinied. Bloody clashes between pro- and anti-monarchists were erupting across the country.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You hoped it would all pass, but th..."
entries.dialogueText:
You hoped it would all pass, but the fire had been lit.

One day, General Azaro burst into headquarters with the news that the navy had mutinied. Bloody clashes between pro- and anti-monarchists were erupting across the country.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You hoped it would all pass, but th..."
entries.dialogueText:
You hoped it would all pass, but the fire had been lit.

One day, class was interrupted by the announcement that the navy had mutinied. Bloody clashes between pro- and anti-monarchists were erupting across the country.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You hoped it would all pass, but th..."
entries.dialogueText:
You hoped it would all pass, but the fire had been lit.

Your next council meeting was interrupted by the announcement that the navy had mutinied. Bloody clashes between pro- and anti-monarchists were erupting across the country.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The head of palace security insiste..."
entries.dialogueText:
The head of palace security insisted you be driven to a safehouse outside of Porte Drazon.

As you left city limits, though, an unmarked car swerved in front of you, blocking the road.

A trio of masked men with guns jumped out, quickly overpowered your guards and forced you out of the vehicle.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You tried to fight them."
entries.dialogueText: You tried to fight them.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You complied with their demands."
entries.dialogueText: You complied with their demands.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You tried to run away."
entries.dialogueText: You tried to run away.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The king insisted you be driven bac..."
entries.dialogueText:
The king insisted you be driven back to the capital immediately.

As you left Iza city limits, though, an unmarked car swerved in front of you, blocking the road.

A trio of masked men with guns jumped out, quickly overpowered your guards and forced you out of the vehicle.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The king insisted you be driven bac..."
entries.dialogueText:
The king insisted you be driven back to the capital immediately.

As you left Montaklar, though, an unmarked car swerved in front of you, blocking the road.

A trio of masked men with guns jumped out, quickly overpowered your guards and forced you out of the vehicle.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You tried to fight them."
entries.dialogueText: You tried to fight them.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your military training kicked in an..."
entries.dialogueText:
Your military training kicked in and you put up a serious struggle. They shot you in the shoulder before you were finally subdued.

As your consciousness faded, you recognized one of your captors' voices: Lucas Sazon, Duke of Brenas and the head of Rizia's third royal house.

A hood went over your head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You ran for your life. But before y..."
entries.dialogueText:
You ran for your life. But before you could get far, you felt a sharp pain in your leg and collapsed.

As your captors caught up with you, you recognized one of their voices: Lucas Sazon, Duke of Brenas and the head of Rizia's third royal house.

A hood went over your head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You recognized one of their voices:..."
entries.dialogueText:
You recognized one of their voices: Lucas Sazon, Duke of Brenas and the head of Rizia's third royal house.

A hood went over your head.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your captors subdued you after only..."
entries.dialogueText:
Your captors subdued you after only the slightest struggle. 

You recognized one of their voices: Lucas Sazon, Duke of Brenas and the head of Rizia's third royal house.

A hood went over your head.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Then, darkness."
entries.dialogueText: Then, darkness.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "They held you captive for nearly a..."
entries.dialogueText:
They held you captive for nearly a week.

When rescue finally came, it was in the form of a man with a white, blue and magenta flag on his fatigues.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Wehlen's flag."
entries.dialogueText: Wehlen's flag.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "At the palace, you pieced together..."
entries.dialogueText:
At the palace, you pieced together what had happened.

In desperation, your father had pleaded for the aid of Rizia's northern neighbor, Wehlen, to neutralize the uprising.

But that help came at a price. Over the next year, the two nations worked out an agreement to transfer control of the port of Zille and its surrounding region -- home to rich natural resources and millions of people.

For the next 25 years, Zille would belong to Wehlen.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You wondered how King Valero could..."
entries.dialogueText: You wondered how King Valero could have been so stupid.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You thanked him for restoring order..."
entries.dialogueText: You thanked him for restoring order.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You were just happy to be alive."
entries.dialogueText: You were just happy to be alive.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You were a constant newspaper fixtu..."
entries.dialogueText:
You were a constant newspaper fixture. They called you the "Party Prince".

One day, the king came for an unannounced visit. He brought with him a pale-skinned young woman with striking blue eyes.

Hesitantly, she introduced herself as Lena Livingston -- the sister of Queen Beatrice of Rumburg, and your wife-to-be.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Valenqiris came to see you as a gen..."
entries.dialogueText:
Valenqiris came to see you as a generous, capable leader.

One day, the king came for an unannounced visit. He brought with him a pale-skinned young woman with striking blue eyes.

Hesitantly, she introduced herself as Lena Livingston -- the sister of Queen Beatrice of Rumburg, and your wife-to-be.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You kissed her hand."
entries.dialogueText: You kissed her hand.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...that your royal duties left you..."
entries.dialogueText: ...that your royal duties left you too busy to spend time with family.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...that your commitment to being a..."
entries.dialogueText: ...that your commitment to being a good husband and father sometimes meant you neglected your work.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...that you couldn't stop yourself..."
entries.dialogueText: ...that you couldn't stop yourself from having the occasional affair.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...tried your best to be a good fat..."
entries.dialogueText: ...tried your best to be a good father.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...ignored your family and threw yo..."
entries.dialogueText: ...ignored your family and threw yourself into your work.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...had a string of affairs."
entries.dialogueText: ...had a string of affairs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "With Rumburg's help, Rizia's econom..."
entries.dialogueText:
With Rumburg's help, Rizia's economy bounced back to levels it hadn't seen since the glory days of Queen Lyza.

Wealthy Rumburgians started moving to the cities. So did economic migrants from neighboring Morella and Derdia, and Wehzeks seeking asylum from the civil war.

You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...were suspicious of these newcome..."
entries.dialogueText: ...were suspicious of these newcomers.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Many of the foreigners ended up in..."
entries.dialogueText:
Many of the foreigners ended up in the province of Brenas, where a nationalist movement called Su Omina began demanding that the King put Rizia "above all".

As Duke of Iza, your uncle Hugo turned a blind eye to Su Omina's activities, while his teenage son Ricardus became a vocal supporter.

Eventually, Ricardus -- better known as Rico -- approached you about speaking at one of the group's rallies.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You agreed."
entries.dialogueText: You agreed.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You refused."
entries.dialogueText: You refused.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You threw your weight behind Su Omi..."
entries.dialogueText:
You threw your weight behind Su Omina, increasing the group's legitimacy and following.

Your parents were displeased, but said nothing.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...happily came along."
entries.dialogueText: ...happily came along.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You distanced yourself from the org..."
entries.dialogueText:
You distanced yourself from the organization and from Rico. 

Your uncle was displeased, but said nothing.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...went, but only for your daughter..."
entries.dialogueText: ...went, but only for your daughter's sake.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...decided to get some work done in..."
entries.dialogueText: ...decided to get some work done instead.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You were putting your clothes back..."
entries.dialogueText:
You were putting your clothes back on when you got the call.

The weather had turned stormy in the middle of the Gulf of Valenqiris. When the captain tried to turn the boat around, it was hit by a breaking wave and cracked in half.

The Coast Guard managed to save Vina on time. But by the time they pulled your wife out, she was barely breathing.

You rushed to the hospital.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "A few years passed."
entries.dialogueText: A few years passed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You found yourself under more and m..."
entries.dialogueText:
You found yourself under more and more pressure to make up for your father's shortcomings. 

Lena was patient and understanding -- one of the many things you loved about her.

For her 10th birthday, Vina asked to go on a sailing trip with the two of you. You...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You found yourself under more and m..."
entries.dialogueText:
You found yourself under more and more pressure to make up for your father's shortcomings. 

Between that and your loveless marriage, you had few sources of joy in your life -- except for Vina.

For her 10th birthday, she asked you and Lena to take her on a sailing trip. You...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...decided to meet your latest love..."
entries.dialogueText: ...decided to meet your latest lover instead.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You were in your office when you go..."
entries.dialogueText:
You were in your office when you got the call.

The weather had turned stormy in the middle of the Gulf of Valenqiris. When the captain tried to turn the boat around, it was hit by a breaking wave and cracked in half.

The coast guard managed to save Vina on time. But by the time they pulled your wife out, she was barely breathing.

You rushed to the hospital.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the middle of the Gulf of Valenq..."
entries.dialogueText:
In the middle of the Gulf of Valenqiris, the weather turned unexpectedly stormy. 

When the captain tried to turn the boat around, it was hit by a breaking wave and cracked in half.

The coast guard got to you and your daughter on time, but by the time they pulled Lena out, she was barely breathing.

They rushed her to the hospital.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "She died holding your hand."
entries.dialogueText: She died holding your hand.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You began to get suspicious as well..."
entries.dialogueText: You began to get suspicious as well.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You wondered what the country was c..."
entries.dialogueText: You wondered what the country was coming to.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...told your father about your trip..."
entries.dialogueText: ...told your father about your trip.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...lied to him about where you'd be..."
entries.dialogueText: ...lied to him about where you'd been.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The king was pleased you'd stood up..."
entries.dialogueText:
The king was pleased you'd stood up to the duke, but furious you had gone behind his back.

He accused you of betrayal.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The king was furious. He accused yo..."
entries.dialogueText:
The king was furious. He accused you of betrayal.

He ordered you to tell him about your meeting with the Duke.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You said nothing and walked out."
entries.dialogueText: You said nothing and walked out.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You exploded at him for being an in..."
entries.dialogueText: You exploded at him for being an incompetent ruler.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You begged for his forgiveness."
entries.dialogueText: You begged for his forgiveness.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You assured him you were on his sid..."
entries.dialogueText: You assured him you were on his side.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As Vina grew into an intelligent, s..."
entries.dialogueText:
As Vina grew into an intelligent, self-reliant young woman, your mother moved from Monqiz back to the capital.

She called you one night, her voice shaking.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You had only occasional contact wit..."
entries.dialogueText:
You had only occasional contact with your father in the months that followed.

As Vina grew into an intelligent, self-reliant young woman, your mother moved from Monqiz back to the capital.

She called you one night, her voice shaking.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "The king was dying."
entries.dialogueText: The king was dying.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...refused to promise anything."
entries.dialogueText: ...refused to promise anything.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The duke accepted your answer. Desp..."
entries.dialogueText:
The duke accepted your answer. Despite his disappointment, he invited you to spend the next few days getting to know him and the duchy better.

Afterwards, you...

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few days later, the King summoned..."
entries.dialogueText:
A few days later, the King summoned you to the capital for a confrontation.

He'd had his personal security force, the Golden Guard, surveil you in Pales. 

He accused you of betrayal and ordered you to tell him about your meeting with the Duke.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few days later, the King summoned..."
entries.dialogueText:
A few days later, the King summoned you to the capital for a confrontation.

He'd had his personal security force, the Golden Guard, surveil you in Pales. 

He was pleased you'd stood up to the duke, but furious you had lied to him. He accused you of betrayal.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You declined."
entries.dialogueText: You declined.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few days later, you received a le..."
entries.dialogueText:
A few days later, you received a letter from Pales.

Duke Reinhart expressed his disappointment that you couldn't meet him, and wrote that he hoped to re-establish relations between Pales and Rizia once you took the throne.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You showed it to the king."
entries.dialogueText: You showed it to the king.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You kept it to yourself."
entries.dialogueText: You kept it to yourself.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Valero thanked you for your honesty..."
entries.dialogueText:
Valero thanked you for your honesty. He confided in you that you were one of the only people he trusted now.

He wrote back to Duke Reinhart that his ploy had failed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few days later, the King summoned..."
entries.dialogueText:
A few days later, the King summoned you to the capital for a confrontation.

He'd ordered his personal security force, the Golden Guard, to begin inspecting family members' mail.

He accused you of betrayal.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...asked him about the protests."
entries.dialogueText: ...asked him about the protests.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "In faith, you finally found solace."
entries.dialogueText: In faith, you finally found solace.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...celebrated Rizia's new diversity..."
entries.dialogueText: ...celebrated Rizia's new diversity.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...welcomed the new arrivals, but w..."
entries.dialogueText: ...welcomed the new arrivals, but were secretly glad that few of them settled in your province.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You slowly realized that the uprisi..."
entries.dialogueText:
You slowly realized that the uprising had broken something in your father.

He began neglecting his duties as he became increasingly preoccupied with threats, both real and imaginary. 

Outside of the country, he gained a new nickname.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Valero the Frail.""
entries.dialogueText: "Valero the Frail."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You went against Duke Reinhart's wi..."
entries.dialogueText: You went against Duke Reinhart's wishes and gave your father every last detail.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You kept your mouth shut."
entries.dialogueText: You kept your mouth shut.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Valero wrote to Duke Reinhart that..."
entries.dialogueText: Valero wrote to Duke Reinhart that his ploy had failed. You heard nothing from Pales after that.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Valero banished you from his sights..."
entries.dialogueText: Valero banished you from his sights. You didn't speak to him at all in the months that followed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You stayed close with your father i..."
entries.dialogueText:
You stayed close with your father in the months that followed, though you were both too busy to see each other as often as you would have liked. 

As Vina grew into an intelligent, self-reliant young woman, your mother moved from Monqiz back to the capital.

She called you one night, her voice shaking.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "There was a new king to crown."
entries.dialogueText: There was a new king to crown.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You remember two things about King..."
entries.dialogueText:
You remember two things about King Valero's coronation: the whispers that Hugo, now the Duke of Valenqiris, was actually the rightful king. And the shouts of protesters outside the palace gates.

Alone with your father after the ceremony, you...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "It felt good to have caring relativ..."
entries.dialogueText: It felt good to have caring relatives.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Even with Hugo advising him as Gran..."
entries.dialogueText:
Even with Hugo advising him as Grand Vizier, King Valero seemed powerless to address the escalating tensions. 

Hugo suggested to the King that you be entrusted with certain responsibilities. Upon agreement from the King and the Royal Council, you were granted the opportunity to aid as the Crown Prince. 

You chose to concentrate on...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...enforcing internal security and..."
entries.dialogueText: ...enforcing internal security and the passing of necessary royal decrees.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...increasing gold extraction and i..."
entries.dialogueText: ...increasing gold extraction and improving tax efficiency.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...enhancing the extraction of oil,..."
entries.dialogueText: ...enhancing the extraction of oil, coal, and gas.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...spearheading a public relations..."
entries.dialogueText: ...spearheading a public relations campaign to boost national opinion of the Royal Family.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Paskal Beniwoll
Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...strengthening the armed forces a..."
entries.dialogueText: ...strengthening the armed forces and building new military formations.

entries.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "The world seemed dull and meaningle..."
entries.dialogueText: The world seemed dull and meaningless.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You believed that things could be b..."
entries.dialogueText: You believed that things could be better.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You attended, but did not speak."
entries.dialogueText: You attended, but did not speak.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You watched as the organizations' l..."
entries.dialogueText:
You watched as the organizations' leaders bemoaned the loss of Rizian territory, identity and values.

They stopped just short of blaming King Valero directly.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You heard nothing from Pales after..."
entries.dialogueText: You heard nothing from Pales after that.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "You were cut off from the world bey..."
entries.dialogueText:
You were cut off from the world beyond the palace walls, but it gave you more time for self-reflection.

During those formative years, you realized...

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "…you desired an easy life, one wher..."
entries.dialogueText: …you desired an easy life, one where you seized every advantage you were entitled to.
entries.menuText: …you desired an easy life, one where you seized every advantage you were entitled to. [Easier Resources]

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "…your royal privilege came with unb..."
entries.dialogueText: …your royal privilege came with unbelievable pressure, and balancing the two would be your life's work.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "…the years ahead would be full of c..."
entries.dialogueText: …the years ahead would be full of challenges, but they would make your triumphs all the sweeter.
entries.menuText: …the years ahead would be full of challenges, but they would make your triumphs all the sweeter. [Harder Resources]
